title: フォーゲットミーノット！

text_block_list.text: My memory… it's gone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black and I are startled by a loud yell, and we race over to the source to find Gold Ship with a troubled expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I can't find my memory from yesterday anywhere! I've looked inside my bag and in the hollow of a tree, but it's nowhere to be seen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: C-calm down! Is there anything we can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sob… My poor, precious little memory. I must've gone and dropped it somewhere…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Please! You've gotta help me find my memory! If I don't find it soon, someone might take it for themselves!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's go and look for that memory, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the three of us go searching around the school.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I can sense it! It's calling out to me! The line of gold must be around here!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So it's in this area? Got it! Let's search carefully to see if it's fallen somewhere or gotten buried!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Urgh, all these weeds are getting in the way. Let's weed the area while we search!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! I found a memory! Wait, this is the one from last week when I squared off against those Martians! This isn't the one I'm looking for!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I sure did! And what a great time it was! ♪ Okay, let's keep going! To the next memory!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Shh! Be quiet! We've gotta look for this darned memory without it noticing us.
choice_data_list: (How can a memory even notice us, though?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay, we'll be quiet. Oh, hold on, let me just tidy up these books. They look like they're going to topple over.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Close, but no cigar! This is tomorrow's memory! WHOA! I'm gonna become the president?!
choice_data_list: (The likeliness of that happening is pretty low!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait! I put away the equipment that was lying around so no one'll trip over it and get hurt! Let's keep looking for that memory!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm… It's not proving easy to find, is it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean I'm going to give up looking for it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Kitasan Black doesn't seem discouraged, I begin to wonder if it's wise to let her keep participating in this fool's errand.
choice_data_list: Do you still believe she's lost her memory?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter if I believe that or not! I just want to help Golshi out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't just ignore someone if they're in trouble. That's why I'll stay and help her until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Kitasan, but we've looked everywhere I can think of…
choice_data_list: Let's check around the school one more time!
We might need to ask for more help…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine… I don't want to become a prisoner to my past. The most important thing is the time spent here and now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It doesn't feel right to leave your memory abandoned and lost, though… I can keep helping you if you like.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's cool. We've killed enough ti—er, I mean… It's all right because I've discovered something even more important than my lost memory!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That the present is more important than the past! As thanks for teaching me this lesson, lemme give you guys something good!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Put some salt in that and shove it under your pillow! You're guaranteed to sleep like a baby, Baby!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Is this some kind of charm?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But what a relief! Golshi looked like a real weight had been taken off her shoulders!
choice_data_list: So, what does the paper say?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Lemme see… "I did it. I'm the one who did everything"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It would seem so. Thank you for all your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Apologies for eavesdropping. I heard that someone was doing good deeds around school and wished to express my gratitude in person.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You helped weed the garden, tidy the library, and put away audio equipment. Each task was an issue submitted in our suggestion box.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I just did all that while I was searching for something, but I'm glad I was able to help out!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even if it was done on a whim, I'm still grateful. One good turn deserves another. This is not much, but here is a reward for your efforts.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wow, these cookies look delicious! I'll divvy them up with Golshi later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is never stingy when helping others, and today I got to see just how big her heart really is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good idea! Maybe if we ask someone else to help—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I've finally found you, Gold Ship! Yesterday, you—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now, wait right there, McQueen. Don't tell me you're gonna ask someone with amnesia about stuff that happened yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What's this? You have amnesia?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So you don't remember singing that weird song in front of my bedroom last night?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nope! I don't remember doing anything like that!
choice_data_list: (Is this what this whole farce was for?!)
(Is this what this whole farce was for?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Are you dragging other people into your lies again? Listen, I didn't come here to scold you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Lately, I've been having trouble falling asleep. I was wondering what you were doing last night when you randomly burst into song, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: For some reason, hearing you sing sent me into a deep, relaxing sleep. I meant to come and thank you…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But I suppose there's no use in that if you can't remember doing it. I'll just take these back with me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wait, you want to give me something? You should've started with that, Big Mack! Oh, my memories have suddenly returned! It's a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You greedy cur! I'm so sorry, you two. Thank you for bearing with her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And they're gone…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm still glad Golshi was able to remember what happened right away. That puts my mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black believed Gold Ship's tall tale until the very end, and she just seems happy to have been of help.
